content: Muli olwôla lusiku, omu cihugo ca Yûda bayimba, mpu:

content.text: Rhugwêrhe olugo luzibuzibu! Aluzungulusize olukûta n’ecôgo mpu lyo arhufungira.
Muhamûle enyumvi: olubaga lushinganyanya lugere, lwo lubaga lurhahemuka!
Buzibu olanga omurhûla, bulya we bacîkubagira.
Mukâcîkubagira Nyakasane ensiku zoshi, bulya Nyakasane abâ lwâla lw’ensiku n’amango.
Nêci, ahenangwîre abàli bayûbasire oku ntondo, n’ecishagala càli cilengerîre acîrhimba oku idaho, acîvumvuza omu katulo.
Carhindagirwa n’amagulu, amagulu g’abagalugalu n’enshando z’abazamba.
Enjira y’omushinganyanya bubà bwîrhonzi, we otwîra omushinganyanya enjira nnongêdu.
Nêci, omu njira y’obucîranuzi bwâwe mwo rhwakazâg’ikulindira, Yâgirwa Nyakasane! Okuderha izîno lyâwe n’okukuyîbuka kwo omurhima gwîrhu gucîfinja.
Omurhima gwâni we gucîfînja budufu, n’omûka gundimwo we gulongereza. Bulya amango otwîra igulu emmanja, lyo abantu b’en’igulu bamanya obushinganyanya.
Erhi bankababalira nyankola-maligo, arhankayigîriraho obushinganyanya; omu cihugo c’obwîrhonzi, yêhe anakâjira ebigalugalu, arhankanabona obukulu bw’irenge lya Nyakasane.

Yâgirwa Nyakasane, okuboko kwâwe kuli kulambûle, ci bôhe barhadwîrhi bakubona! Bacibona kurhi oyâgalwa n’olu lubaga, n’enshonyi zibabumbe! Nêci, omuliro gurheganyizîbwe abanzi bâwe, nabo gwâbafonfomera!
Yâgirwa Nyakasane, we orhushobôza omurhûla, n’ebijiro bîrhu byoshi, wêne orhukolerabyo.
Yâgirwa Nyakasane, Nyamuzinda wîrhu, abandi barhegesi barhali we barhurhambwîre; ci izîno lyâwe dolodolo rhukola rhugashâniza.
Banyakwigendera barhakac’ishubiramw’omûka, ebizunguzungu birhakacîfûla! Bulya wabahanyire wanabamalîra, wazâza ciru n’izîno lyâbo.
Wayûshwîre olubaga, Yâgirwa Nyakasane! Wayûshwîre olubaga, wayêrekana irenge lyâwe; watundugusire embibi z’ecihugo zoshi.
Yâgirwa Nyakasane. omu marhabi, bàkubirikire; erhi bagogomerwa n’obuhane bwâwe, bàgwîra bakushenga.
Nka kula omukazi oli izîmi, erhi amango gâge g’okuburha gahika, ayâma erhi mikero erhuma, ntyôla kwo nîrhu rhwàli rhuyôsire embere zâwe, Yâgirwa Nyakasane!
Rhwabîre izîmi, rhwayumva emikero, ci rhwabà nk’abamaburha empûsi! Ntà bucire rhwalerhîre ecihugo, na ntà bantu bahyâhya rhwaburhîre igulu!

Abafu bâwe bâshubiramw’omûka, n’emirhumba yâbo yafûka. Zûki, muyimbe n’omwîshingo, mwe mugwishîre omu katulo! Bulya olumè lwâwe luli lumè lwa bulangashane, n’igulu lyâshub’iburha balya bâli bakola bizunguzungu.

content: «Kanya, lubaga lwâni, ojè omu nyumpa zâwe, onacîyîgalirekwo enyumvi; orhang’icîfulika kasanzi kasungunu kuhika obukunizi bugere.

“Bulya, alà oku Nyakasane oyo wamâhuluka omu ndâro yâge, mpu ayish’ihana amabî g’abantu ba hano igulu. Nalyo idaho likola lyâshala omukò lyanywîre, lirhakanaciderha mpu lyafulika abantu bâlyo banizirwe”».
